method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (tar-core.l4: built-in date functions only, the provisions of the Transport Accident Act 1986 the Regulations complete restated narrowly with their sections, and the Regulations' rules) and one seat layer that restates no rule (tar-seat.l4, 13 questions with @export and @desc); two regulative rules (ss 49(4), 50(4), 51(5) with r 7; s 64(1), (3) with r 8(1)), tested by EVALTRACE, never taken as inputs; no REFUSE (a case outside the encoding answers NOTHING, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Transport Accident Regulations 2017 (Vic), S.R. No. 40/2017, Version No. 002, incorporating amendments as at 23 October 2018 (current on 2026-11-07), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/transport-accident-regulations-2017.txt, converted from the Word file the owner saved by hand on 2026-11-07; with the provisions it completes of the Transport Accident Act 1986 (Vic), Act No. 111/1986, Version No. 159, as at 1 November 2026
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) State of Victoria, not openly licensed, deposited and quoted as an unofficial version under the owner's ruling of 24 October 2026, with the Government Printer's notice; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual the Regulations are applied to: the person injured in a transport accident (severe injury; home or vehicle modification), the person receiving weekly payments for loss of earning capacity (statement of earnings), the driver, owner or owner's parent or guardian asked to report an accident, and the owner of a trailer insured with the Commission or a person in charge of it

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tar-core.l4 ; l4 run tar-seat.l4 ; l4 run tar-cases.l4
checks.result: 102 written, 102 satisfied in tar-cases.l4; 0 errors, 0 warnings in all three files (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; a copy of the case file with one expected value changed was run first to confirm failures are reported (101 satisfied, 1 failed), and not kept.

scope: In: r 5(1), (2) with Act s 3(1) (severe injury); r 7 with Act ss 49(4), 50(4), 51(5) and Form 1 (statement of earnings); r 8(1), (2) with Act s 64(1)-(3) and Forms 2, 3 (accident reports); r 9 and Form 4 cll 2, 3 with Act s 86 (trailer contract of insurance); r 10 (transitional); r 11 with Act s 60(3)-(5) (the $50 000 home modification amount). Out: rr 1-4, 6 (machinery); the fields of Forms 2 and 3; Form 4 cl 1 and cl 2(2)(a); Act s 60(4A), (4B), (6), ss 65, 66. See NOTES.md.
also_reads: subjects/au/vic/transport-accident-act-1986 (Version No. 159): s 3(1), s 49(4), s 50(4), s 51(5), s 60(3)-(5), s 61(2), s 64(1)-(4), s 86, restated narrowly
